data.title: Soluna and Bitdeer Agree 28 MW Bitcoin Co-Mining Deployment in Texas
data.description: Soluna Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:SLNH) has signed a co-mining agreement with Dory Creek, LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of Bitdeer Technologies Group (NASDAQ:BTDR), covering the deployment of approximately 28 MW of Bitcoin mining equipment at Soluna’s Project Kati 1 data centre in Willacy County, Texas.
data.keywords: Bitcoin mining, data centre, Soluna, Bitdeer
